failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of solvent exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 60°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure

failure_modes.cause: Deposition of reaction by-products at high temperatures
failure_modes.mitigation: Implement regular cleaning schedule and monitor temperature differentials

failure_modes.cause: Particulate formation due to solvent impurities
failure_modes.mitigation: Install inline filters and perform regular solvent quality checks

validation_experiments: Run blank solvent at Q=0.5 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Conduct thermal cycling test from 40°C to 70°C to assess heat exchanger fouling
Perform particle size analysis on solvent to ensure no particulates > 10 microns
